title: 1 Million Cups Springfield
description: 1 Million Cups Springfield is a weekly in-person networking meetup held every Wednesday at the Sunshine Event Center on the 3rd floor of the Plaza Towers, with free coffee and a live podcast hosted by Run It Studios that you can stay for. Admission is free. This session is on December 2, 2026, Time TBD, at 1736 E Sunshine St Ste 300, Springfield, MO; check social media for updates or cancellations due to holidays or weather.
